title: Signal inputs: recent Messages, human votes with reasons, concept links, pending verdicts
description:
New module src/papyrus_content/ideas/signal_inputs.py: one read pass per publication that loads what the signals need, through the existing GraphQL client (no new fields on the models):
- Message threads and Messages with createdAt, author kind and text: listMessageThreadsByAnchorAndUpdatedAt / listMessagesByThreadAndCreatedAt / listMessagesByKindAndCreatedAt (amplify/data/resource.ts L1801-1895). Only Messages from people count as human signal (epic PPY-781d26).
- Reference votes: curationStatus, curationStatusUpdatedAt/By, curationStatusReason, curationReasonCode, curationActorKind (only "human" trains) via listReferencesByCurationStatusKeyAndUpdatedAt; both dates (createdAt, sourcePublishedAt).
- Reference -> concept edges: SemanticRelation current rows with predicate mentions OR related_to whose object is a semanticNode (related_to is the human "relates to this concept" link, Ryan 11-01).
- Pending References with a positive relevance verdict (relevance_decision_is) as context only.
- Published Items and existing ideas (incl. spiked) for repeat suppression.
Load once, return a frozen snapshot object; paginate everything (no caps). Unit tests with a fake client.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
